name: 杰克·萨托
introduction: Jake Satow is an American actor known for The Dropout, Adeline, Gaslit, and Saving Christmas Spirit. Jake is a SAG AFTRA actor who has appeared in feature films, television mini series, music videos, and commercials. He has also performed in professional theater productions, including G. Bruce Smith's LA based play, The Honorary Consul. Jake loves to sing and play the keyboard in his local band in his free time. He also enjoys arranging music. He enjoys modeling and has done runway modeling for various Fashion Weeks across the country, Macy's, Homage, and others. He has also done product modeling, including featuring on the box of Huffy Bicycle's Green Machine.Jake is always excited to continue to hone his acting craft and has trained extensively with private coaches including John Kirby, John D'Aquino, Wendy Faraone, Corey Martin Craig, and the AFA Studios in Burbank, and voice training with Claire Hosterman. He has attended extensive workshops and classes at The Groundlings LA, Talent House Academy, Zak Barnett Studios, AClassACT New York, and Camp Hollywood.Jake is thrilled to be represented by Exclusive Artists Agency/Rebecca Ek in Calabasas, California and to have Nikki Mincks/MTM Talent Management as his manager, and Melissa Berger as his publicist.In his free time, Jake loves to be involved in philanthropy in his community, spending time with family, and he enjoys playing tennis, weightlifting, football, kayaking, and staying fit.
